marketing_description: The Philips 391227 fluorescent bulb is a 32 W, 1150 lm option with a T9 shape and E26 base, offering a soft white light appearance at 30000 K. This dimmable bulb features a clear finish and has an average life of 25000 hours. It is also Title 20 Compliant and offers benefits such as being energy efficient, long lasting, and environmentally friendly.
